emits.description: Step north (keyboard keyMap or d-pad directionEvents); pushes an adjacent crate when the cell beyond is free
Step south (keyboard keyMap or d-pad directionEvents); pushes an adjacent crate when the cell beyond is free
Step west (keyboard keyMap or d-pad directionEvents); pushes an adjacent crate when the cell beyond is free
Step east (keyboard keyMap or d-pad directionEvents); pushes an adjacent crate when the cell beyond is free
Resets crates, pusher, and counters to the authored level
Emitted when every crate sits on a target (result solved)

events.name: Move Up
events.description: Step north (keyboard keyMap or d-pad directionEvents); pushes an adjacent crate when the cell beyond is free

events.name: Move Down
events.description: Step south (keyboard keyMap or d-pad directionEvents); pushes an adjacent crate when the cell beyond is free

events.name: Move Left
events.description: Step west (keyboard keyMap or d-pad directionEvents); pushes an adjacent crate when the cell beyond is free

events.name: Move Right
events.description: Step east (keyboard keyMap or d-pad directionEvents); pushes an adjacent crate when the cell beyond is free

events.name: Play Again
events.description: Resets crates, pusher, and counters to the authored level

events.name: Game End
events.description: Emitted when every crate sits on a target (result solved)
